plugins.name: mam
plugins.description: Multi-Agent Methodology - session-based Architect/Implementor workflow with persistent state, structured sprint artifacts, and bus-based crossover with PDT

plugins.name: mama
plugins.description: Multi-Agent Methodology with Agents - team-based workflow with direct user interaction, persistent working knowledge, and bus-based crossover with PDT

plugins.name: pdt
plugins.description: Product Design Thinking - Socratic design partner for pre-implementation product thinking, concept development, documentation crystallization, and bus-based crossover with MAM/MAMA

plugins.name: bus
plugins.description: Peer messaging bus - connects PDT, Architect, Implementor, and UX Designer sessions for direct cross-session communication via Claude Code's agent-team mailbox protocol, with turn-bounded delivery discipline, chat-mode for lightweight exchanges and consult-mode for durable structured artifacts

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Stakeholder documentation sharing - publish selected markdown as docx to a synced folder, pull comments + tracked changes + untracked body edits back as per-signal feedback files, ship response companion docx with full disposition history on each publish

plugins.name: plumb
plugins.description: MAMA's successor: not a better methodology, but a host for a methodology the project authors and evolves, plus an evidence layer that works with no methodology at all. Keeps the Product Owner as decider and removes them as lifecycle operator. Ships mechanical guards for repeatedly-observed failures, an interrupting peer-messaging bus, a process host surfaced as MCP tools (roles, norms, decision numbers — with retired-role refusals), a pluggable execution ledger (nonlinear/GitHub/Jira/Linear/markdown), the drive protocol, read-before-rule design gates, and compaction survival. Skills carry sequence; the project's own way-of-working document carries norms, and wins where they disagree.
